# Figment Studio LLM Access Notes

This site represents Figment Studio, an architectural visualization company based in Abuja, Nigeria.

- https://figmentstudio.ng/
- https://figmentstudio.ng/about

Core services:
- Architectural rendering
- Cinematic 3D walkthrough animation
- Interior and exterior visualization
- Concept support and design communication
